detail.longDescription: most study apps are timers, but time only tells you how long you sat there. So with NOTEON, my study app, I went a different way: it asks you to snap a photo of your notes at random moments, and you and your friends keep an eye on each other. You can pad the numbers in a study log, but you can't fake the page of notes you had at that exact moment. https:// note.com/ryo_devlog/n/na0c73f2 8d851 # studying # studytwt # productivity
